title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteer Event at Convoy of Hope
description: A Giving Tuesday volunteer event where participants count, sort, box and bag product for Hands of Hope at Convoy of Hope Headquarters, with projects varying by need and a cleanup of the work area at the end. It is sponsored by the Republic Area Chamber of Commerce; youth 10-12 must come with a parent or guardian and a signed consent form, and everyone needs a current liability waiver on file and closed-toe shoes. It takes place Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM at the Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, Springfield, MO.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
